topic: Why do some AI models fail at counting letters, and what fixes it?

sentences.text: Why do some AI models fail at counting letters?
sentences.editorial: question, transition or recommendation drawn from the measured results

sentences.text: We asked two models twenty questions, once plainly, once spelling it out first.
A real reply: it spells the word, then counts.
Asked plainly, Google's Flash-Lite got sixteen right.
On random letters, six of ten became ten.
OpenAI's GPT-OSS was perfect either way.
Why? Models read tokens, not letters.
Strawberry is one tokens, but ten letters.
So make the model spell it out first.
